issues.detail: Threads TH1 (13 messages), TH2 (12 messages), TH3 (10 messages), and TH4 (10 messages) have fewer messages than the expected minimum of 15. Additionally, all threads fall short of their target_messages_range specified in the blueprint.

The ICT system analyst (494954) repeatedly uses the exact same phrasing to summarize and confirm decisions across all threads (e.g., 'Let me summarize...', 'Let me confirm...', 'So let me confirm D5...'). This makes the dialogue feel scripted and robotic.
